prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in steps consistently hurt performance across tests.
Adoption copy, finish layout, and home wait-info changes showed no clear effect across tests.
No kind of change proved helpful, as no test achieved a winning result.
Predictions were generally too high across most tests, though some negative predictions in Round 4 were too low.
Evidence remains thin for adoption new_flow, adoption new_screen, choose_path hint, choose_path redesign, finish incentive, finish notification, home new_flow, home redesign, sign_in hint, and sign_in redesign, as each has only 1 test so far.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] adoption_companion_pledge_screen: Adds a companion pledge sign-off screen immediately after picking a pet to build emotional commitment before photo upload. (why: Adoption has the highest funnel drop-off at 39.1% (60.9% conversion). An explicit commitment pledge anchors user interest before higher-friction steps.)
1: [adoption, redesign] pick_friend_two_column_redesign: Redesigns the pet selection screen into a side-by-side two-column layout displaying pet stats alongside pet choices. (why: Adoption step drops significantly to 60.9%; a structured two-column layout lets users compare companion traits without endless scrolling.)
2: [home, redesign] waiting_centered_stage_redesign: Redesigns the waiting screen into a focused stage layout centered around the pet hatching animation. (why: The home wait step has a median duration of 201s and 18.7% drop-off; a centered stage format maintains visual focus during generation.)
3: [sign_in, hint] sign_in_account_recovery_hint: Displays a clear hint reassuring users that signing in restores prior pets and syncs existing profile data across devices. (why: Support received 8 emails reporting pets missing or reset after signing in again, making explicit account recovery reassurance essential.)
4: [finish, layout] home_intro_full_bleed_layout: Switches the finish screen (home_intro) to a full-bleed celebratory layout highlighting screen completion. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% with high mean time (5815s); a full-bleed view clearly signals onboarding completion.)
5: [home, notification] waiting_notify_ready_toggle: Enables an automatic readiness notification toggle on the waiting screen so users are notified when pet creation finishes. (why: Mean time spent on the waiting screen is 2336s (~38 minutes), leading to drop-offs while users wait away from the desktop.)
6: [adoption, copy] upload_photos_clarity_copy: Updates the headline and body text on the photo upload screen to give explicit guidance on photo resolution and lighting. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet creation failing or rendering incorrectly from photo uploads.)
7: [choose_path, layout] story_carousel_layout: Changes the intro story screen to a swipeable carousel layout breaking companion background lore into visual cards. (why: The mean time spent on choose_path/story is 514s; presenting information in visual carousel cards reduces initial reading friction.)
